items.title: Global Demand for Water | AQA GCSE Geography | Water 1
items.description: Introduces global patterns of water demand, explaining why some areas face surplus while others face severe deficit.

items.title: Causes of Water Insecurity | AQA GCSE Geography | Water 2
items.description: Covers the physical and human factors that cause water insecurity, including climate, geology, pollution and poverty.

items.title: Impacts of Water Insecurity | AQA GCSE Geography | Water 3
items.description: Examines the social, economic and environmental consequences of water insecurity for people in LICs and NEEs.

items.title: Water Security | GCSE Geography
items.description: Concise overview of global water security linking surplus and deficit regions to real-world impacts.

items.title: Our Planet (2019)
items.description: David Attenborough narrates this Netflix series; the Fresh Water episode explores rivers and wetlands under growing human pressure.

items.title: Planet Earth II (2016)
items.description: BBC landmark series with sequences showing ecosystems entirely dependent on freshwater availability.

items.title: Brave Blue World (2019)
items.description: Optimistic documentary examining innovative technologies and policies tackling the global freshwater crisis.

items.title: David Attenborough: A Life on Our Planet (2020)
items.description: Attenborough's witness statement and vision for the future, including the consequences of freshwater loss and environmental degradation.

items.title: Impacts of Water Insecurity - Internet Geography
items.description: Clear notes on health, food production, industrial output and conflict caused by water insecurity, with case study examples.

items.title: Impacts of Water Insecurity - Coolgeography
items.description: Illustrated revision page on the consequences of water insecurity, ideal for AQA Paper 2 exam preparation.

items.title: Impacts of Water Insecurity - Seneca Learning
items.description: Interactive revision notes and practice questions on water insecurity impacts, matched to the AQA GCSE specification.

items.title: Water Surplus and Water Deficit - REVISE GCSE Geography (Seneca Learning)
items.description: Short revision podcast covering global patterns of water surplus and deficit and what drives water insecurity around the world.
